evidence.supports: Prospect Peak Fire Lookout on Prospect Peak in Lassen Volcanic NP, near Mineral
evidence.quote: The Prospect Peak Fire Lookout is a fire lookout station located on Prospect Peak in Lassen Volcanic National Park, near the city of Mineral, California.
The lookout, which was built circa 1912, is one of the oldest extant U.S. Forest Service fire lookouts in the United States.
The lookout was added to the National Register of Historic Places on March 30, 1978.
Though the station was ultimately abandoned and has lost its original windows and roof shingles, it is otherwise intact.

corrections.why: NRHP 78000295 is the Prospect Peak Fire Lookout on the summit of Prospect Peak in Lassen Volcanic National Park, an abandoned lookout probably built around 1912. The NHLR entry for this lookout does not list it.
That is the National Register name of the Lassen Volcanic National Park structure, not of West Prospect Peak Lookout in Lassen National Forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1935 for the present cab. A June 1938 newspaper item counts Gus Kramer's 17th year at West Prospect, so a station was staffed on the peak earlier. The sources read do not say what it was.

notes_for_editor: Proposed corrections are for human review, not applied. The record's NRHP 78000295 and other name point to the Prospect Peak Fire Lookout in Lassen Volcanic NP; Wikipedia and the 1977 nomination both describe that structure as abandoned on Prospect Peak in the park. Unresolved: Wikidata Q14683716 puts its coordinates at the West Prospect site (40 35 38 N, 121 22 45 W) and records a 1981 'structure relocation' for the NRHP lookout, while Wikipedia gives 40.573 N, 121.345 W for the park lookout. Check the NRHP location and any move before accepting the registers correction. Current status and access are not verified: the search also returned an ALERTCalifornia camera page and a syncrosafari page saying the tower is still in service, but neither was read (page budget). The weebly header says Shasta-Trinity NF; the register and 1955 inspection say Lassen NF and Hat Creek District. The record's kind 'two_story' was not checked against the register's 'enclosed timber tower' with a cab on top. The story now says the NRHP listing 'appears' to belong to a different structure, because the Wikidata coordinate conflict above is still open.
